hotels.title: Charming English Countryside Escape in The Cotswolds with Daily Breakfast & One-Time Dinner
hotels.description: Claim your own little corner of the Cotswolds at Burleigh Court, where sweeping Golden Valley views come with a garden spa and award-winning dining. Set within four acres of gardens near Stroud, this Grade II-listed manor has all the ingredients for a romantic country escape, with just 18 individually styled bedrooms spread across the historic property. The Wellness Garden Nature Spa makes slowing down a particularly tempting prospect. Sink into the blissful hot tub, admire the countryside from the barrel sauna or brave a refreshing dip in the Art Deco plunge pool. For an extra dose of indulgence, book a massage in the garden treatment hut, then stretch out on a lounger. At The Burleigh restaurant, the surrounding countryside supplies much more than the view. Seasonal British menus champion produce harvested from the hotel’s garden served in an oak-panelled dining room. Make an afternoon of homemade scones and clotted cream, or take your pre-dinner drink onto the terrace as the valley stretches out below.
